# Simulate data

Dates

```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(3111963)
# define N
n=1e7
# define start and end of registry
start_date=as.Date("2005-01-01")
end_date=as.Date("2022-12-31")
max_days=as.numeric(end_date - start_date)
# simulate dates
backward_days=rtruncexp(n=n,
                        rate=0.0002,
                        max=max_days)
# calculate onset date
onsetdatev=end_date-floor(backward_days)
```

Covariates

```{r}
df=data.frame(id=1:n,
              onsetdate=onsetdatev,
              ageonset=runif(n,0.5,6),
              u=runif(n,0,1),
              e=rnorm(n,0.5,0.02),
              z=rexp(n),
              sex=sample(c('male','female'),n,replace=T)) %>% 
  mutate(calendar_c=year(onsetdate)-mean(year(onsetdate)),
         trialdate=as.Date('2021-05-31'))
pzero=0.5
taud=2*365.25
```

# Tune

## Build filtered dataset

```{r}
prep_wait = function(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  df %>% 
    mutate(ptrt     = plogis(t_int - t_age*ageonset + t_sex*(sex=="male")),
           eligible = stopdate >= trialdate,       
           trt      = as.integer(u < ptrt & eligible),
           duration = ifelse(trt==1, trialdate-onsetdate, round(timedays))) %>% 
    filter(duration > 0,
           !(trt==0 & onsetdate >= trialdate))   # controls must be historical (onset before the trial date)
}
```

## Bias after matching

```{r}
bias_wait = function(d, t = 730){
  tr = d[d$trt == 1, ]
  ct = d[d$trt == 0, ]

  # controls sorted by survival time, with suffix sums of their risk
  o      = order(ct$timedays)
  tc     = ct$timedays[o]
  rc     = (1 - exp(-ct$hazard * t/30))[o]
  suffix = c(rev(cumsum(rev(rc))), 0)
  N      = length(tc)

  # for each treated wait w: controls still alive (timedays > w)
  idx  = findInterval(tr$duration, tc)      # number of controls with timedays <= w
  n_el = N - idx
  ok   = n_el > 0                           # treated with at least one alive control

  risk_ctrl = mean(suffix[idx[ok] + 1] / n_el[ok])
  risk_trt0 = mean(1 - exp(-tr$hazard[ok] * t/30))
  risk_trt0 / risk_ctrl - 1                 # naive RR / true RR - 1
}
```

## SMDs bias

```{r}
get_targets_wait = function(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  d = prep_wait(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex)
  c(smd_age  = abs(smd::smd(d$ageonset, d$trt)$estimate),
    smd_sex  = abs(smd::smd(d$sex, d$trt)$estimate),
    rel_bias = bias_wait(d))
}
```

## Solve for the treatment and outcome parameters

```{r}
make_hazard = function(df, s){
  lp  = s*(-0.43*df$ageonset + 0.28*(df$sex=="male")) - 0.01*df$calendar_c + df$e
  lam = uniroot(function(l) mean(1 - exp(-l*exp(lp)*taud/30)) - pzero,
                interval=c(0,1e15), tol=1e-12)$root
  df %>% mutate(hazard   = lam*exp(lp),
                timedays = z/hazard*30,
                stopdate = onsetdate + timedays)
}

get_targets_wait = function(df, t_int, t_age, t_sex, s){
  d = prep_wait(make_hazard(df, s), t_int, t_age, t_sex)
  c(smd_age  = abs(smd::smd(d$ageonset, d$trt)$estimate),
    smd_sex  = abs(smd::smd(d$sex, d$trt)$estimate),
    rel_bias = bias_wait(d))
}

solve_wait = function(df, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, target_bias,
                      t_int = 1, start = c(0.97, 1.9, 0.6)){
  target = c(target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, target_bias)
  obj = function(par) sum((get_targets_wait(df, t_int, par[1], par[2], par[3]) - target)^2)
  o = optim(start, obj, method="Nelder-Mead", control=list(reltol=1e-10, maxit=1000))
  c(t_int=t_int, t_age=o$par[1], t_sex=o$par[2], s=o$par[3], loss=o$value)
}
```

## Get values given targets

```{r}
par = solve_wait(df, 0.5, 0.5, 0.20)
par
get_targets_wait(df, par["t_int"], par["t_age"], par["t_sex"], par["s"])
```
